Pennsylvania. Minimum relative humidity values will drop to
around 35 percent this afternoon. This will be accompanied by

properties.description:

* WHERE...In Oregon, Clackamas County Cascade Foothills, East Central

plumbing.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Frost and freeze headlines are only issued
through the growing season of April 1 through October 31.

November 1, even though similar low temperatures are possible.

this growing season for the Upper Hood River Valley, southern
Willamette Valley, south Washington Cascade Foothills, and north
Oregon Coast Range as these locations have already experienced a
hard freeze earlier in October.
properties.instruction:

sensitive to cold temperatures.

Consider temporarily covering sensitive plants with a lightweight
cotton fabric (i.e., bedsheets, thin blankets), as this will help
retain heat and provide frost protection for your plants.
